exposure: maternal residence in counties that had obstetric unit closures within 5 years before birth year
cohort: The study included children born in Iowa between 1994 and 2009 whose birth certificate data was linked to school test scores through 2017-2018, whose mothers resided in counties that had obstetric unit closures.
finding: There is overall little evidence that obstetric unit closures within 5 years before birth impact children's math and reading scores and infant health and maternal care outcomes.
mod_finding: Obstetric unit closures showed small and not statistically significant associations with cesarean delivery and labor induction.
